title: The Beast is a psychological thriller, disguised as a love story, presented in a dystopian sci-fi setting.

commenti.body: I wanted to love this one. Yet, despite some beautiful imagery of a flooded Paris, there was little to admire besides the performances. George Mackay especially shines in the latter part of the film as an incel type loner. I’m usually not a book over the movie type a guy, but the original story is a masterpiece. There is an impeding doom over the novella that the film strives for but never reaches.
